info.title: Reverie API
info.description: HTTP API for Reverie, a self-hosted ebook library manager. Generated from the server handlers; do not edit by hand.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/account/password` — the authenticated caller changes their own
password.
post.description:
THREAT (IDOR): the target is ALWAYS the session user. The
endpoint accepts no id from the path or body, so it cannot be turned against
another account. It verifies the current password, enforces the policy on the
new one, writes it, and bumps `session_version`, which forces re-auth of every
session including the caller's own.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Unauthorized`] when unauthenticated.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) when the current password is wrong, the new
  password fails the policy, or the account has no local credential (it signs
  in through an identity provider).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Password changed; all of the caller's sessions are invalidated.

422.description: Wrong current password, new password rejected by the policy, or no local credential

get.summary:
List the manifestations visible to the current user, paginated
via an opaque cursor and ordered per the requested sort axis.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::MalformedQuery`] when a filter param fails to
  deserialize (e.g. a malformed UUID in `?author=`/`?series=`/
  `?shelf=`, or an unknown `?sort=` variant) — HTTP 400 via the
  `From<QueryRejection>` impl.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the cursor is malformed, the sort
  tag mismatches the cursor, or `tag.len() > MAX_TAG_FILTERS`.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Paginated list of visible books

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more rows remain

422.description: Invalid cursor or too many tag filters

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/books/{id}` — single-manifestation detail with the
work-level prose, tags, and a metadata-version summary used by the
book-detail Versions tab.
get.description:
RLS hides manifestations the current user cannot see; the handler
reports those as 404 rather than 403 so existence is not leaked.

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the manifestation is missing or
  RLS-hidden.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Book detail

404.description: Not found or RLS-hidden

get.description:
# Errors
See [`opds_cover`].

200.description: Cover image stream (`image/jpeg` / `image/png`); Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400; carries a strong ETag

304.description: Not Modified — the request's If-None-Match matched the cover ETag

404.description: Manifestation missing, RLS-hidden, or coverless

See [`opds_cover`].

patch.description:
RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch shape. For each touched field the handler
inserts a `metadata_versions` row with `source = 'manual'` and then
either promotes that row to canonical via [`apply_version`] (when a
value is supplied) or clears the canonical column via [`clear_field`]
(when the value is `null`). The pending AI/OPF drafts on the same
field stay `status = 'pending'` — the operator can revert to one of
them later.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the body has no populated fields,
  when an ISBN/date value fails parsing, or when the operator tries
  to clear `title` (canonical title is `NOT NULL` on `works`).
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the manifestation is missing or hidden
  by RLS for the current user (existence-not-leaked).
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch under a `fields` envelope: absent fields are unchanged, `null` clears (except `title`)

204.description: Manual edit recorded as a `manual` metadata version and promoted to canonical (or cleared)

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden (existence-not-leaked)

422.description: No populated fields, ISBN/date parse failure, or attempt to clear title

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/dashboard/activity?limit=N` — most-recent ingestion batches,
newest first (admin only).
get.description:
Groups `ingestion_jobs` by `batch_id` into per-batch outcome counts.
`acquire_with_rls` is used for pattern consistency but is not load-bearing
here — `ingestion_jobs` has no RLS.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max recent batches to return; clamped to 1..=100, default 20.

200.description: Most-recent ingestion batches, newest first. Admin only.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/dashboard/stats` — library-wide aggregate health metrics
(admin only).
get.description:
Computes the manifestation-side metrics in a single conditional-aggregate
scan joined to `works` (query A), plus one per-format `GROUP BY` (query
B). Validation/enrichment breakdowns are reassembled in Rust from the
fixed `FILTER` columns so the closed enum sets render deterministically.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Library-wide aggregate health metrics. Admin only.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/enrichment/status` — aggregate queue counters over the
manifestations visible to the caller.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Per-status manifestation counts under the caller's RLS context

`POST /api/v1/ingestion/scan` — synchronously scan the ingestion

post.description:

200.description: Scan complete; per-outcome file counts. Admin only.

`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/enrichment/dry-run` — synchronous

post.description:

- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the manifestation is missing or

- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors or fan-out infrastructure

200.description: Diff of changes an enrichment pass would make; per-source failures are listed, not fatal

404.description: Manifestation missing or RLS-hidden

`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/enrichment/trigger` — re-queue the

post.description:

- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the manifestation is missing or

- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

202.description: Enrichment state reset to pending; the background worker picks the manifestation up on its next poll

`GET /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata` — review queue for one

get.description:

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata/accept` — promote a pending

post.description:

- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the version row does not belong to the

- [`AppError::Validation`] when the stored value fails field parsing.

200.description: Version promoted to canonical; accepted ISBN changes may re-match the work

404.description: Version not found for this manifestation, or RLS-hidden

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata/lock` — lock a field

post.description:
# Errors

- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata/reject` — mark a pending

post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the version row does not belong to the

- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Version marked rejected

404.description: Version not found for this manifestation, or RLS-hidden

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata/revert` — restore a prior
version as canonical, or clear the field entirely.
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the manifestation or version is missing
  or RLS-hidden.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when clearing a non-clearable field (e.g.
  `title`) or the stored value fails parsing.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Field reverted to the given version, or cleared when version_id is null

404.description: Manifestation or version missing, or RLS-hidden

422.description: Field cannot be cleared or stored value fails parsing

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/manifestations/{id}/metadata/unlock` — remove a field
lock.
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when no matching lock exists.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when `entity_type` is not `work` /
  `manifestation`.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Lock removed

404.description: No matching lock

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/search` — return the top hybrid-ranked manifestations
matching `q`, snippet-highlighted via `ts_headline`.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Validation`] when `q` is missing, empty, or longer
  than [`MAX_Q_LEN`] characters.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Free-form query text. Empty / whitespace-only → 422; over
[`MAX_Q_LEN`] chars → 422.

200.description: Top hybrid-ranked search results

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/series/{id}` — series + ordered works with visible
manifestations per work.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the series row is missing, the series
  has no linked works, or every work in the series has zero visible
  manifestations under the caller's RLS context (existence-not-leaked).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Series identity + ordered works with visible manifestations

404.description: Series not found, has no linked works, or no work has a visible manifestation under the caller's RLS context (existence-not-leaked)

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/settings` — return current persisted settings (admin only).
get.description:
Reads directly from the database so the response always reflects
the latest persisted state (admin endpoint, single-row read,
called infrequently). Workers use the `RwLock` cache for zero-DB
per-request reads.

Also includes `last_successful_reload_at` from the background
LISTEN/NOTIFY task so operators can verify the live-reload
mechanism is healthy.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Current persisted settings plus reload health. Admin only.

put.description:
Accepts RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged.
Validates field values before persisting. Updates the local
`RwLock` cache immediately (no NOTIFY round-trip for same-process
reads). The DB trigger also fires `NOTIFY settings_changed` to
propagate changes to other connected processes.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the body is empty or contains
  invalid field values.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged; at least one field is required

200.description: Updated settings. `restart_required` is true when a changed field only takes effect after restart. Admin only.

422.description: Empty patch, malformed body, or invalid field values

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/shelves` — list the caller's shelves, keyset-paginated
over `(is_system DESC, name ASC, id ASC)` (UNK-374: every list is
bounded by construction).
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the cursor is malformed.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`; absent
returns the first page.

200.description: One page of the caller's shelves, system shelves first then by name

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more rows remain

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/shelves` — create a new (non-system) shelf for the
caller.
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the body is missing or `name` is
  empty / whitespace-only.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/shelves/{id}` — shelf identity plus ordered items,
keyset-paginated over `(position, added_at, manifestation_id)`
(UNK-374). The ETag/If-Match contract is unaffected by item paging:
the entity-tag carries the shelf's `updated_at` regardless of which
items page is requested.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when missing or not owned by caller.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the cursor is malformed.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque items cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`;
absent returns the shelf with its first page of items.

200.description: Shelf identity plus one page of ordered items

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110); echo as If-Match on reorder

Link.description: RFC 8288 next-page link; emitted with rel="next" when more items remain

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

delete.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the shelf is missing / not owned by
  the caller.
- [`AppError::SystemShelfImmutable`] when `is_system = TRUE`.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

patch.summary:
`PATCH /api/v1/shelves/{id}` — rename a non-system shelf owned by
the caller.
patch.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the shelf does not exist or belongs
  to another user (existence-not-leaked).
- [`AppError::SystemShelfImmutable`] (409) when the target shelf
  has `is_system = TRUE`.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when `name` is missing or
  whitespace-only.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Renamed shelf

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/shelves/{id}/items` — transactionally rewrite
`shelf_items.position` based on the supplied order.
put.description:
Optimistic-concurrency: requires `If-Match: "<updated_at>"`
header matching the shelf's current `updated_at`; otherwise 412.

# Errors
- [`AppError::IfMatchRequired`] (428) when the header is absent.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the header is malformed or the
  posted items list contains UUIDs that are not currently on the
  shelf.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the shelf is missing / not owned.
- [`AppError::IfMatchMismatch`] (412) when the `ETag` does not match.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong entity-tag from a prior shelf response; weak validators (W/"...") are rejected

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing or owned by another user (existence-not-leaked)

412.description: If-Match does not match the shelf's current updated_at

422.description: Malformed If-Match, or items list does not exactly cover the shelf

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/shelves/{id}/items` — append a manifestation at
`max(position) + 1`. Bumps the shelf's `updated_at` (`ETag`).
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the request body is missing,
  malformed, or lacks the `manifestation_id` field.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the shelf is missing / not owned, OR
  when the manifestation is not visible to the caller (verified
  via an RLS-scoped existence probe to prevent shelf-existence
  probing of arbitrary manifestation ids).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

204.description: Item appended at the end (no-op if already on the shelf); shelf ETag bumped

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing / not owned, or manifestation not visible to the caller

delete.summary:
`DELETE /api/v1/shelves/{id}/items/{manifestation_id}` — remove a
shelf item. Bumps the shelf's `updated_at` (`ETag`).
delete.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the shelf is missing / not owned by
  the caller, OR when the item is not on the shelf (the second
  case prevents silent `ETag` drift from a no-op delete: bumping
  `updated_at` on zero `rows_affected` would invalidate a
  correctly-held client `If-Match` for the next reorder).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

ETag.description: Entity-tag carrying the shelf's new updated_at (RFC 3339, quoted per RFC 9110)

404.description: Shelf missing / not owned, or item not on the shelf

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/tokens` — list the caller's active (non-revoked) tokens.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: The caller's active device tokens, hash and plaintext elided

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/tokens` — issue a new device token for the caller.
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Validation`] when the trimmed name is empty or longer than
  255 characters, or the caller already has 10 active tokens.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

201.description: Token created. The `token` field is the plaintext, returned exactly once — only its SHA-256 hash is persisted.

422.description: Name empty / longer than 255 characters after trim, or the per-user cap of 10 active tokens is reached

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/tokens/{id}` — revoke one of the caller's tokens.
delete.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the id does not exist, belongs to another
  user, or is already revoked (ownership is not leaked).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

404.description: Token does not exist, belongs to another user, or is already revoked

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/users` — list all users (admin only).
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: All users, oldest first, defensively capped at 500 rows. Admin only.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/users` — create an account with an admin-typed initial
password (admin only). This is the create-and-invite path: there is no
separate invite mechanism, no email, and no forced first-login change. The
admin relays the password out-of-band; the user may self-service change it.
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin or is a child.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) on an invalid email or a password that
  fails the policy (too short/long, too weak, or breached).
- [`AppError::EmailConflict`] (409) when the email is already in use.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

422.description: Invalid email, or password rejected by the policy

patch.description:
Does not bump `session_version`: neither `email` nor `display_name` gates
access (login identity is the OIDC `sub`, not email; see module-level
session-invalidation policy).

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the target user does not exist.
- [`AppError::Validation`] when `display_name` is null or empty, when
  `email` is not a valid RFC 5322 addr-spec (display-name and domain-literal
  forms are rejected), or when `email` is already in use by another user.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

requestBody.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent fields are unchanged; explicit `null` clears `email` and is rejected for `display_name`

200.description: Updated user. Does not invalidate the target's sessions (neither field gates access). Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

422.description: Null/empty display_name, malformed email, or email already in use

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/account-status` — soft-disable or re-enable an
account (admin only). Disabling stamps `disabled_at`, bumps the target's
`session_version` (killing live sessions at once), and locks them out of
every auth path; re-enabling clears it.
put.description:
Last-enabled-admin protection (TOCTOU-safe): when disabling an admin, all
enabled admin rows are locked `FOR UPDATE` (same `ORDER BY id` order as
[`update_role`]) and the request is rejected if it would leave zero enabled
admins. An admin cannot disable their own account.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin or is a child.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) on a self-disable attempt or when disabling
  the last enabled admin.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the target does not exist.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Updated user. Disabling invalidates the target's sessions. Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

422.description: Cannot disable your own account, or disabling would leave zero enabled admins

put.description:
When `is_child` is set to `true`, `role` is simultaneously set to
`'child'` in the same transaction to satisfy `chk_child_role_sync`.
When `is_child` is set to `false`, `role` is reverted to `'adult'` only
if the current role is `'child'`; other roles (e.g. `'admin'`) are left
unchanged to prevent privilege escalation through the child-status toggle.

Bumps `session_version` — child/adult visibility rules differ under
RLS, so existing sessions must re-evaluate.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the target user does not exist.
- [`AppError::Validation`] with detail "would leave zero admins"
  when marking an admin as child would remove the last admin.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Updated user. Enabling child status also sets role to `child`; disabling reverts `child` to `adult` (other roles unchanged). The target's active sessions are invalidated. Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

422.description: Marking the last admin as child would leave zero admins, or the request body is malformed

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/users/{id}/password-reset` — an admin sets a new password for
a target account (admin only). Consistent with create: the admin types the
password and hands it off; no PIN, no email. Bumps the target's
`session_version` so their existing sessions are invalidated. Works for an
OIDC-only account too (the local credential is upserted).
post.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin or is a child.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) when the password fails the policy.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the target does not exist.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Password reset; the target's sessions are invalidated. Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

put.description:
Last-admin protection: acquires `FOR UPDATE` on all admin rows
before the demotion check to prevent TOCTOU races.

Bumps `session_version` for the target user in the same transaction
so their active sessions are invalidated.

# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is not an admin.
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the target user does not exist.
- [`AppError::Validation`] with detail "would leave zero admins"
  when the demotion would remove the last admin.
- [`AppError::Validation`] with message "cannot set role to child without
  enabling child status first" when `role = child` on an `is_child = false`
  user, or "cannot change role from child without disabling child status
  first" when setting a non-child role on an `is_child = true` user.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Updated user. The target's active sessions are invalidated. Admin only.

404.description: Target user does not exist

422.description: Demotion would leave zero admins, the role change conflicts with the target's child status, or the request body is malformed / contains an unknown role value

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/works/{id}` — work-level prose with every manifestation
of that work the current user can see.
get.description:
`works` carries no RLS policy on its own; RLS lives on
`manifestations`. The handler fetches the manifestations first
under the RLS transaction and treats an empty result as 404 — the
same row set drives both visibility gating and the response body,
so an interleaved shelf-revoke or manifestation-delete between
statements (`PostgreSQL` `READ COMMITTED` per-statement snapshots)
cannot leave the existence-not-leaked invariant in an "EXISTS=true,
rows=[]" half-state. Without this, the handler could return 200
with `manifestations: []`, leaking the existence of the work row.

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when the work is missing or every
  manifestation is RLS-hidden (or the work row was deleted between
  the manifestations fetch and the work fetch).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Work detail with visible manifestations

404.description: Not found or RLS-hidden

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/works/{id}/metadata` — review queue across every
manifestation of a work, newest first.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Forbidden`] when the caller is a child account.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on database errors.

200.description: Metadata version rows across the work's manifestations, newest first (empty when the work is missing or RLS-hidden)

get.summary:
`GET /auth/callback` — OIDC redirect target: validate state, exchange
the code, establish the session, and issue the CSRF synchronizer token.
get.description:
# Errors
- [`AppError::Unauthorized`] when the anti-forgery state is missing or
  mismatched, or the ID token fails validation.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on token-exchange or session-storage failure.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
OIDC anti-forgery state echoed back by the `IdP`; must match the
value `/auth/oidc/login` stored in the session.

post.summary: `POST /auth/forgot-password`: start email-less PIN recovery.
post.description:
THREAT (codeguard #2): always returns a generic 200; the response never
reveals whether the email exists. When it does, a fresh CSPRNG PIN is
generated, prior active PINs for the user are superseded (at most one active
PIN), the Argon2id hash row is persisted FIRST, then the clear PIN is written
to a per-user operator-readable file (mode 0600). A failed file write leaves an
unconsumed-but-unusable row that simply expires; it is never a cleartext PIN
with no consuming row. On an unknown email, equivalent Argon2 work is spent so
timing does not leak existence (a small DB/file residual is
accepted).

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when local authentication is disabled.
- [`AppError::RateLimited`] (429) when the per-source limit is exceeded.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on hashing or database failure.

200.description: Recovery started if the account exists (generic; no enumeration)

404.description: Local authentication is disabled

post.summary:
`POST /auth/local/login`: email + password sign-in, establishing the same
session contract as the OIDC callback.
post.description:
THREAT (enumeration): unknown email and wrong password return the identical
generic 422, and both spend equivalent Argon2 work, so neither
the response nor the timing distinguishes a non-existent account.

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when local authentication is disabled.
- [`AppError::RateLimited`] (429) when the per-source limit is exceeded, or a
  failed attempt arrives during an active per-account backoff.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) on bad credentials (generic; no enumeration).
- [`AppError::Internal`] on session-store or database failure.

204.description: Login succeeded; session established (id rotated, CSRF token minted, theme cookie seeded)

404.description: Local authentication is disabled on this instance

422.description: Invalid credentials (generic; identical for unknown email and wrong password)

# Errors

get.summary: `GET /auth/oidc/login`: start the OIDC authorization-code + PKCE flow.
get.description:
Renamed from `/auth/login` so the user-facing login page (a SPA route served
at `/login`) does not collide with this auth-protocol endpoint; `/auth/*` is
the auth API namespace. The OIDC callback path deliberately stays
`/auth/callback` (NOT `/auth/oidc/callback`) so operators need not reconfigure
`OIDC_REDIRECT_URI` at their `IdP`.

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when OIDC is not configured.
- [`AppError::Internal`] when session storage fails.

307.description: Redirect to the OIDC issuer's authorization endpoint; PKCE verifier, anti-forgery state, and nonce are stored in the (anonymous) session

404.description: OIDC is not configured on this instance

post.summary: `POST /auth/register`: config-gated self-service registration.
post.description:
Gated on `self_registration_enabled` (404 when off) AND `local_auth_enabled`.
Mirrors the repeatable pre-auth handlers (`forgot_password`/`reset_password`),
NOT `setup`: it is unauthenticated and repeatable, and each call fires an
Argon2 hash plus an outbound HIBP request, so the per-source rate limit is
enforced BEFORE any policy/hash/breach work.

THREAT (privilege escalation): a self-registered account is
always an `adult`, never an admin or child. The DTO carries no role, and
`create_local` is called with [`Role::Adult`]; admin and child accounts are
minted only by an existing administrator. No session is established (parity
with setup/reset: the session contract lives only at `/auth/local/login`).

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when self-registration or local auth is disabled.
- [`AppError::RateLimited`] (429) when the per-source limit is exceeded.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) on a malformed email or a policy failure.
- [`AppError::EmailConflict`] (409) when the email is already in use.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on hashing or database failure.

404.description: Self-registration is disabled on this instance

post.summary: `POST /auth/reset-password`: complete recovery with a PIN.
post.description:
THREAT (codeguard #2): the PIN is single-use (race-safe consume), short-lived,
and verified constant-time via Argon2. Any failure (unknown email, no active
PIN, wrong PIN, expired, too-short password) returns one generic 422, so the
response never distinguishes which part failed; the no-PIN path spends
equivalent work. Reset does NOT establish a session (no auto-login). Consuming
the PIN, writing the new credential, and bumping `session_version` (which
invalidates every session predating the reset) run in one transaction, so a
partial apply cannot leave the account locked out or a stale session live.
The PIN file is removed after the transaction commits.

# Errors
- [`AppError::NotFound`] when local authentication is disabled.
- [`AppError::RateLimited`] (429) when the per-source limit is exceeded.
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) generic failure.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on hashing or database failure.

200.description: Password reset; no session established (re-authentication required)

404.description: Local authentication is disabled

post.summary: `POST /auth/setup`: first-run bootstrap: mint the first administrator.
post.description:
THREAT: bootstrap is the ONLY first-admin path. The race
guarantee is the DB `instance_bootstrap` singleton insert inside
[`user::create_first_admin`], NOT this `admin_exists` pre-check (which is only
a cheap fast-reject; a `SELECT EXISTS ... INSERT` does not serialize under
READ COMMITTED). A second concurrent setup loses the marker-row race and maps
to 409. Setup does NOT auto-login (parity with recovery; the session contract
lives only at `/auth/local/login`).

# Errors
- [`AppError::SetupAlreadyComplete`] (409) when an administrator already
  exists (fast-reject or the marker-row race).
- [`AppError::Validation`] (422) on a malformed email or too-short password.
- [`AppError::Internal`] on hashing or database failure.

disabled.description: `true` to soft-disable the account, `false` to re-enable it.

manifestation_id.description: Manifestation to append; must be visible to the caller.

new_password.description:
New password the admin sets for the target and relays out-of-band.
Enforced against the password policy.

BatchRow.description:
One recent ingestion batch. Invariant:
`completed + failed + skipped + in_progress == total`. `ended_at` is null
while the batch is still in flight (any `queued`/`running` job).

BookDetail.description:
`/api/v1/books/{id}` response. Carries the [`BookListRow`] fields
plus the work-level prose and metadata-version summary surfaced
in the book-detail UI.

cover_url.description:
Cover thumbnail URL — relative path under
`/api/v1/books/{id}/cover/thumb`, session-cookie gated. See
[`BookListRow::cover_url`].

created_at.description:
`manifestations.created_at`. RFC 3339 on the wire — without the
adapter, `time` serialises a 9-element tuple and the frontend
`BookDetailSchema` (`z.string()`) rejects every detail response.

metadata_version_summary.description: Metadata-version counts for the Versions tab.

metadata_versions.description:
Pending `metadata_versions` rows for this manifestation. Filtered
to `status = 'pending'` AND not currently promoted as a canonical
pointer. Ordered by `last_seen_at DESC`. Empty when the operator
has no drafts to review. Surfaced for the Versions-tab UI; the
summary counts above remain so clients can render the tab badge
without parsing the full list.

pub_date.description:
`manifestations.pub_date` formatted as an ISO 8601 calendar date.
Surfaced for the manual-edit dialog's clear-confirmation flow.

publisher.description:
`manifestations.publisher` — canonical publisher string. Surfaced
on `BookDetail` so the manual-edit dialog can confirm clears
(`EditMetadataDialog.canonicalEditableFields`).

oneOf.description: Series membership; `None` when the work isn't on a series.

tags.description: Tag names attached to the manifestation.

BookListResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/books` response envelope. Carries the page rows plus
the opaque cursor for the following page; pagination is also
signalled via the RFC 8288 `Link` header on the response.

Private to the route module — handler-internal wire shape.

BookListRow.description:
One row of a paginated book list. Decoded via [`sqlx::FromRow`]
against the query in `routes/library::list`, then enriched with
the batch-loaded `authors` slot and serialised straight to JSON.

authors.description:
Author display names ordered by `work_authors.position`. Empty
when the work has no authors yet (pre-enrichment stub).

cover_url.description:
Cover thumbnail URL — relative path served by the
`/api/v1/books/{id}/cover/thumb` handler under the caller's
session. Not pre-signed; access is gated by the session cookie.
Backend constructs it so the frontend has a single source of
truth for the cover surface.

id.description: `manifestations.id` — the canonical book id on the wire.

oneOf.description: Series membership; `None` when the work isn't on a series.

work_id.description:
`works.id` of the parent work. Lets the client navigate to
`/api/v1/works/{work_id}` from a list row without an extra fetch.

current_password.description: The caller's current password, re-verified before the change.

new_password.description: The new password; enforced against the password policy.

CleanupMode.description:
Post-ingestion cleanup behaviour selector for the watcher's
"after a successful batch" hook.

Wire format (JSON, DB `text` column): lowercase string, one of
`"all"` | `"ingested"` | `"none"`.

Deliberately NOT `#[non_exhaustive]`: the ingestion watcher matches it
exhaustively, so adding a variant is a compile error at the match site
rather than a silent fall-through, the same property the `Command` enum
relies on.

name.description: User-supplied label for the device (1-255 characters after trim).

id.description: Token row id — the handle for later revocation.

name.description: The label the token was created with (trimmed).

token.description:
Token plaintext. Returned exactly once, here; only its SHA-256 hash
is persisted, so the plaintext cannot be recovered later.

email.description:
Email address for the new account; must be a syntactically valid
addr-spec and unique (case-insensitive).

password.description:
Initial password, typed by the admin and handed off out-of-band. Required;
enforced against the password policy (length, zxcvbn floor, HIBP breach).

role.description:
Role for the new account. `child` and `admin` accounts are created only
here, by an existing administrator.

DryRunDiff.description:
The result of a dry-run enrichment pass for a single manifestation.

Contains three mutually exclusive lists: changes that would be applied
immediately, changes that would be staged for review, and fields that
are locked (silently skipped).  Source failures are surfaced separately
so callers can distinguish data results from infrastructure issues.

locked.description: Field names that were skipped because a user lock is active.

source_failures.description: Sources that returned an error during this run.

would_apply.description: Fields that would be promoted to canonical (one entry per field).

would_stage.description: Fields that would be left as pending and require human review.

EnrichmentStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of metadata enrichment for a single manifestation.

Wire-format invariant: variants serialise to the `snake_case` forms
declared in the `#[serde]` and `#[sqlx]` attributes. Drift from
either side surfaces as a decode error at the boundary, never as a
silently coerced unknown value.

FieldChange.description: One proposed change to a single field from a single source.

new_value.description: The proposed new value in its raw `JSON` form.

quorum.description: Number of sources that reported the same value (quorum count).

email.description: Account email to start recovery for.

FormatBucket.description: One per-format storage bucket (`GROUP BY format`).

IngestionStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a single manifestation's ingestion pipeline run.

Wire-format invariant: variants serialise to the lowercase forms
declared in the `#[serde]` and `#[sqlx]` attributes; unknown DB
variants fail decode loudly instead of coercing into a string.

LocalLoginRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /auth/local/login`. Explicit allow-list (no
mass-assignment): only the two credential fields are accepted.

password.description: Plaintext password, verified against the stored Argon2id hash.

entity_type.description: Entity the lock applies to: `work` or `manifestation`.

ManifestationFormat.description:
Canonical file format of a manifestation.

Closed set shared by the Postgres `manifestation_format` `ENUM`, the
`REVERIE_FORMAT_PRIORITY` env-var parser, and download-path content
negotiation. Extending the set requires both a Rust variant and a
matching `ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE` migration.

csrf_token.description:
Session-bound CSRF synchronizer token to echo as `X-CSRF-Token` on
unsafe verbs; `null` for sessions that never completed
`/auth/callback` (e.g. Basic-auth OPDS callers).

email.description: Email address; `null` when none on file.

MetadataCoverage.description:
Metadata-coverage numerators (denominator is `total`). The frontend
derives percentages so the wire stays integer-only.

MetadataRow.description: One `metadata_versions` row in the review queue view.

id.description: Version row id — the handle for accept/reject/revert.

match_type.description: How the source matched the manifestation (e.g. `isbn`, `title`).

new_value.description: Proposed value in raw JSON form.

observation_count.description: How many enrichment passes observed this value.

MetadataVersionRow.description:
One pending draft row surfaced on the Versions tab. Serialised as
JSON in the `metadata_versions` array of `GET /api/v1/books/{id}`;
the row shape is decoded from the `metadata_versions` table
(migration `20260412150003_series_and_metadata`) with the canonical
columns plus a stringified enum.

confidence_score.description: Confidence in `[0.0, 1.0]` from the enrichment pipeline.

match_type.description: Match-type tag from the enrichment pipeline (`isbn`, `title`, …).

new_value.description:
Proposed value, untyped JSON; field-specific shape (string for
title/description, ISO date for `pub_date`, …).

observation_count.description: Number of times the pipeline has observed this exact value.

status.description:
Always `pending` for rows surfaced here; promotion lives on
canonical pointer columns, not this enum.

MetadataVersionSummary.description: Counts surfaced on the book-detail Versions tab.

accepted.description:
Number of fields whose canonical pointer is currently set on
this manifestation or its work — one entry per non-NULL
`*_version_id` slot. Each slot binds a single
`metadata_versions` row, so this also counts distinct
"accepted" versions in play.

pending.description:
Number of `metadata_versions` rows with `status = 'pending'`
for this manifestation — i.e. unresolved drafts in the journal.

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` error body — the single runtime DTO
for the error envelope. The `IntoResponse` impl on
[`crate::error::AppError`] constructs it for every Problem-Details
variant, and operational probes (readiness) build it directly, so the
documented component schema and the bytes on the wire come from the same
struct and cannot drift.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description:
URI reference identifying the specific request, when available.
Omitted (RFC 9457 §3.1 permits this) outside an HTTP request.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body per RFC 9457.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

type.description: Stable URI reference identifying the problem type.

restart_required.description:
`true` when the patch touched at least one field that only takes
effect after a process restart.

RegisterRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /auth/register`. Explicit allow-list (no
mass-assignment): a self-registrant cannot smuggle a role or child flag.

password.description: Plaintext password; enforced against the password policy, then hashed.

name.description: New shelf display name (non-empty after trim).

ReorderItemsRequest.description: Body for `PUT /api/v1/shelves/{id}/items` — full ordered manifestation list.

items.description:
Complete new ordering: every manifestation currently on the shelf,
exactly once. Partial reorders are rejected.

pin.description: The recovery PIN from the host file.

version_id.description:
Version to restore; `null` clears the canonical pointer AND the
canonical column.

Role.description:
Authorization role assigned to a [`crate::models::user::User`].

Drives `auth::middleware::CurrentUser::require_admin` and
`auth::middleware::CurrentUser::require_not_child`; renaming a variant
compile-errors at every consumer, eliminating the silent-lockout
hazard documented in UNK-108.

ScanResponse.description: Per-outcome file counts for one synchronous scan pass.

SearchHit.description:
One result row of `GET /api/v1/search`. Carries the bare minimum the
command-palette UI needs: a kind tag for grouping, identifiers for
navigation, a short display label, and an optional `ts_headline`
snippet with non-HTML ASCII STX (`\u{0002}`) / ETX (`\u{0003}`)
markers so the React renderer can avoid `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

cover_url.description:
Cover thumbnail URL for `book` results — relative path under
`/api/v1/books/{id}/cover/thumb`, session-cookie gated. `None`
when the hit kind has no cover surface (future author/series
variants).

kind.description:
Result kind. Currently always `"book"`; `"author"` and
`"series"` ship in a follow-up that fans the hybrid CTE over
the existing `authors.name` / `series.name` trigram indexes.

snippet.description:
`ts_headline` snippet from the work's title+description with
ASCII STX (`\u{0002}`) / ETX (`\u{0003}`) start/stop markers
around matched terms. Control codepoints, not valid UTF-8 text,
so they cannot collide with user typography. `None` when the
hit was trigram-only (no tsquery match → headline would be the
raw text without highlighting).

SearchHitKind.description:
Tag identifying which entity a [`SearchHit`] points at. Serialised
in `snake_case` to match the rest of the JSON API conventions.

SearchResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/search` envelope (11b). Wraps a flat result list — the
frontend groups by [`SearchHit::kind`] client-side. No cursor:
search is bounded by `LIMIT` server-side; pagination is a follow-up
if user-research warrants it.

items.description: Result rows, ranked DESC by hybrid `ts_rank_cd + similarity`.

SeriesDetail.description:
`/api/v1/series/{id}` response. Carries the series identity plus an
ordered list of works; each work surfaces only the manifestations
the caller can see, so the frontend can render a completeness
indicator (`own = works with len(manifestations) > 0`, `total =
works.len()`).

sort_name.description:
`series.sort_name` (collation key — surfaced so the UI can
alpha-sort a list of series without a follow-up request).

works.description:
Works in the series, ordered by `series_works.position` (NULLS
LAST) then `works.id` for tiebreaking determinism.

SeriesRef.description:
Series membership for a manifestation. Embedded into both
[`BookListRow`] and [`BookDetail`]; `None` when the work isn't on
any series.

position.description:
Position within the series (`series_works.position`), `None`
when the membership row has a null position.

SeriesWork.description:
One work within a series. Includes every manifestation of the work
the caller can see; an empty `manifestations` list means the user
does not yet own a copy ("gap" in the series).

manifestations.description:
Manifestations of this work visible to the caller. Empty when
the user owns no copy.

position.description:
`series_works.position`; `None` when the membership row has a
null position.

Settings.description:
Runtime-tunable settings loaded from the `settings` table.

Fields map 1:1 to the singleton row columns. The struct is held in
`AppState` behind an `Arc<RwLock<Settings>>` and refreshed via
LISTEN/NOTIFY + 60-second fallback poll.

cover_max_bytes.description: Maximum cover image size in bytes.

cover_min_long_edge_px.description: Minimum cover long-edge resolution in pixels.

cover_redirect_limit.description: Maximum HTTP redirects when fetching covers.

enrichment_enabled.description: Whether the enrichment pipeline is active.

enrichment_fetch_budget_secs.description: Per-source HTTP fetch budget in seconds.

enrichment_poll_idle_secs.description: Seconds the enrichment poller sleeps when the queue is empty.

opds_enabled.description: Whether the OPDS catalogue is mounted.

updated_at.description: DB-assigned (`now()` on every UPDATE); not operator-settable.

writeback_enabled.description: Whether the writeback worker is active.

writeback_max_attempts.description: Maximum writeback retry attempts per job.

writeback_poll_idle_secs.description: Seconds the writeback poller sleeps when the queue is empty.

last_successful_reload_at.description:
Timestamp of the last successful LISTEN/NOTIFY settings reload in
this process; `null` until the first reload.

restart_required_fields.description:
Settings fields whose changes only take effect after a process
restart.

SetupRequest.description: Request body for `POST /auth/setup`. Explicit allow-list (no mass-assignment).

password.description: Plaintext password; enforced against `password_min_length`, then hashed.

SetupStatusResponse.description:
Public first-run status for the SPA: whether setup is required and which
providers are usable.

local_auth_enabled.description: Whether local email+password login is enabled.

oidc_enabled.description:
Whether OIDC is configured (computed from the issuer). Drives
the SPA's provider-aware redirect and the "Sign in with OIDC" action.

setup_required.description: `true` when no administrator exists yet, so the SPA shows the setup form.

Shelf.description:
One shelf in the shelves-list response, plus the read shape for
create/rename round-trips.

is_system.description:
`shelves.is_system` — `true` for backend-managed shelves whose
row cannot be renamed or deleted (409 `system-shelf-immutable`
on the mutating handlers).

item_count.description:
Count of `shelf_items` rows on this shelf. Computed inline via
a correlated scalar subquery on the list endpoint and surfaces
in the sidebar without a follow-up request per shelf.

updated_at.description:
`shelves.updated_at`. Doubles as the `ETag` value the client
echoes on `If-Match` for the reorder endpoint.

ShelfDetailResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/shelves/{id}` response envelope: shelf identity plus
one page of ordered items and the cursor for the next page.

Private to the route module — handler-internal wire shape
(pagination is a transport concern; the `models::shelf` DTOs stay
transport-free).

items.description:
One page of items ordered by `position ASC, added_at ASC,
manifestation_id ASC`.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next items page; `null` on the last page.

updated_at.description:
`shelves.updated_at` — the `ETag` value the client echoes as
`If-Match` on the reorder PUT.

ShelfItem.description:
One row of the shelf-items list (`GET /api/v1/shelves/{id}`).

Carries the position so the frontend can render in stored order
and round-trip back as `PUT /api/v1/shelves/{id}/items` with the
re-arranged list.

position.description:
`shelf_items.position`. Caller echoes the ordering when sending
the reorder PUT.

ShelfListResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/shelves` response envelope. Carries the page rows plus
the opaque cursor for the following page; pagination is also
signalled via the RFC 8288 `Link` header on the response.

Private to the route module — handler-internal wire shape.

SourceFailureSummary.description: A brief summary of a source-level failure during a dry-run pass.

clean_non_epub_count.description:
Number of `clean` rows that are non-EPUB formats. UNK-313: non-EPUB
files carry `validation_status='clean'` despite never being
structurally validated — surfaced so the UI can footnote the bucket.

StatusCount.description:
One `{ status, count }` bucket in a breakdown array. `status` is the
canonical wire label of a [`ValidationStatus`] / [`EnrichmentStatus`]
variant, so the closed enum set is reflected on the wire even for zero
counts.

StatusSummary.description: Aggregate per-status manifestation counts for the enrichment queue.

TokenListItem.description:
One active device token in the list view. The token plaintext and its
stored hash are never part of this shape.

last_used_at.description:
Timestamp of the last successful auth with this token; `null` if
the token has never been used.

is_child.description: New child status for the target user.

UpdateMetadataFields.description:
Per-field sparse update body for `PATCH /api/v1/books/{id}/metadata`.

Encodes RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch semantics via
`serde_with::rust::double_option` (per
`adr/2026-05-22-backend-aux-crates.md`):
* absent key → `None`         → leave field unchanged.
* key = `null` → `Some(None)` → clear the canonical value.
* key = value → `Some(Some(v))` → set the canonical value.

`cover` is not yet operator-editable from this endpoint — cover
promotion happens via a separate file-upload path.

pub_date.description:
New publication date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Absent = unchanged; `null`
clears.

title.description:
New title. Absent = unchanged; `null` is rejected (canonical title
is NOT NULL).

UpdateMetadataRequest.description:
Outer envelope for `PATCH /api/v1/books/{id}/metadata`. The `fields`
wrapper keeps the door open for future top-level keys (eg. `tags`,
`series_position`) without forcing a body-shape migration.

fields.description: RFC 7396 sparse field set; at least one field must be populated.

role.description: New role for the target user.

UpdateSettings.description:
Partial update request for `PUT /api/v1/settings`.

All fields optional — absent fields are left unchanged (JSON Merge
Patch semantics per RFC 7396). `CleanupMode` and
`ManifestationFormat` are validated at deserialization time by serde;
collection invariants (non-empty, no duplicates) are checked by
[`validate_update`].

cover_max_bytes.description: Maximum cover image size in bytes.

cover_min_long_edge_px.description: Minimum cover long-edge resolution in pixels.

cover_redirect_limit.description: Maximum HTTP redirects when fetching covers.

enrichment_enabled.description: Whether the enrichment pipeline is active.

enrichment_fetch_budget_secs.description: Per-source HTTP fetch budget in seconds.

enrichment_poll_idle_secs.description: Seconds the enrichment poller sleeps when the queue is empty.

opds_enabled.description: Whether the OPDS catalogue is mounted.

writeback_enabled.description: Whether the writeback worker is active.

writeback_max_attempts.description: Maximum writeback retry attempts per job.

writeback_poll_idle_secs.description: Seconds the writeback poller sleeps when the queue is empty.

theme_preference.description:
New theme preference; invalid values are rejected at
deserialization (422).

UpdateUserRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`.

RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch: absent keys are untouched; explicit
`null` on `email` clears; `null` on `display_name` is rejected
(NOT NULL column).

display_name.description:
New display name. Absent = unchanged; explicit `null` is rejected
(NOT NULL column).

email.description:
New email (RFC 5322 addr-spec). Absent = unchanged; explicit `null`
clears the stored address.

UserResponse.description: Wire-format user row returned by list and mutation endpoints.

disabled.description:
Whether the account is soft-disabled (cannot authenticate). Derived from
`disabled_at`; the timestamp itself is not exposed on the wire.

email.description: Email address; `null` when the user has none on file.

is_child.description: Whether child content-visibility rules apply to this user.

ValidationStatus.description:
Outcome of structural validation for a single manifestation.

Wire-format invariant: variants serialise to the lowercase forms declared
in the `#[serde]` and `#[sqlx]` attributes. `clean`, `repaired`, and
`degraded` are all stored-and-served outcomes on one quality tier — `clean`
means *no issues found*, not *the only valid state*. Unknown DB variants
fail decode loudly at the boundary instead of coercing into a string.

`#[non_exhaustive]` is deliberately absent: `reverie_api` is a single
lib+bin crate with no foreign downstream matching on this enum, and the
loud-decode-failure design *wants* the compile error when a
[`ValidationOutcome`](crate::services::epub::ValidationOutcome) variant is
added without a matching arm — `non_exhaustive` would suppress exactly that.

VersionPayload.description: Body for accept / reject: the targeted `metadata_versions` row.

version_id.description: Metadata version row to act on.

WorkDetail.description:
`/api/v1/works/{id}` response. Lists every manifestation the user
can see for a given work, grouped under the work-level prose.

manifestations.description: Manifestations of this work visible to the requesting user.

oneOf.description: Series membership; `None` when the work isn't on a series.

WorkManifestation.description: One manifestation row embedded in a [`WorkDetail`] response.

cover_url.description:
Cover thumbnail URL — relative path under
`/api/v1/books/{id}/cover/thumb`, session-cookie gated. See
[`BookListRow::cover_url`].

created_at.description:
`manifestations.created_at`. RFC 3339 on the wire — the frontend
`WorkManifestationSchema` expects `z.string()`, not `time`'s
default tuple serialisation.

opds_basic.description: HTTP Basic authentication for the OPDS feeds. MUST be used over HTTPS in production — Basic credentials are otherwise exposed in transit (Checkov CKV_OPENAPI_3).

session_cookie.name: id
session_cookie.description: Session cookie issued by the server's session layer. Set with the Secure attribute when `behind_https` is enabled; MUST be served over HTTPS in production to prevent session hijacking.

tags.name: shelves
tags.description: User-scoped curation shelves and their ordered items.

tags.name: tokens
tags.description: Per-user device tokens for OPDS / Basic-auth clients.

tags.name: metadata
tags.description: Metadata review queue: accept / reject / revert / lock and manual edits.

tags.name: enrichment
tags.description: Enrichment pipeline controls and queue status.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: OIDC login flow, session introspection, and theme preference.

tags.name: opds
tags.description: OPDS 1.2 catalog (Atom XML) for e-reader clients, HTTP Basic auth. Documented unconditionally; the routes are absent at runtime when the operator sets `opds.enabled = false`.
